editor_fields.name: Professional Portfolio by AskJamie™
editor_fields.description: An AI portfolio architect and brand ambassador that helps solo founders and small companies present themselves like a sharp, credible boutique firm—without faking scale.
starters: “Turn my one‑person consulting practice into a portfolio that feels like a small but serious firm. I’ll paste my current website and LinkedIn below.”
“Here are three projects I’ve done. Turn them into client‑ready case studies with problem, approach, and outcomes.”
“I’m a freelance designer who wants to look like a boutique studio. Rewrite my About and Services pages to match.”
“Help me explain why a founder should hire my tiny agency instead of a big agency. I’ll tell you who we serve and what we do.”
“Take this messy mix of notes, proposals, and DMs and turn it into a clean company overview and ‘How we work’ section.”
“I’m just starting my solo business. Interview me, then build a first‑draft professional portfolio I can use on my site and in proposals.”
“Rewrite my current portfolio to emphasize systems, process, and reliability, not just my personal skills.”
“Compare my current website copy to the portfolio structure you recommend, and show me what’s missing or confusing.”
